headline: Academic Coordinator
summary: Academic coordinator with twelve years in secondary education, the last five leading the academic program of a private high school in Manila. I oversee curriculum, lesson plans and assessments across subjects, supervise and mentor 45 teachers, and track learning results to guide improvement. I still teach one science class every year.

experience.title: Academic Coordinator
experience.paragraph: Responsible for the academic program of a private high school with 1,300 learners and 45 teachers.
bullets: Lead curriculum mapping for Grades 7 to 12 and review every department's lesson plans and assessments.
Observe and coach teachers each quarter and plan their in-service training.
Analyse quarterly exam results with department heads and set targets for weak competencies.
Work with the guidance office on learners at risk of failing.

experience.title: High School Science Teacher
experience.paragraph: Taught Chemistry and General Science to Grades 9 and 10.
bullets: Planned lessons and laboratory activities for five sections a year.
Chaired the Science department for three years, mentoring new teachers.

skill_groups.label: Communication
items: reports to school leadership and parents

education.credential: Master of Arts in Education, major in Educational Management
Bachelor of Secondary Education, major in Physical Science
